actions_performed: Three read-only host samples at approximately 10-second intervals
Read-only grouped libproc RUSAGE_INFO_V0 footprint sample
Fetch official public source/config text into memory and AST-parse Python without importing MLX
actions_not_performed: No app close/kill/unload or service changes
No global cache purge or sysctl writes

host_sample_summary.decision: Pressure2 on all three samples: do not start model work. Existing swap alone is not a failure threshold; its growth and pressure matter.

grouped_process_memory.measurement: libproc.proc_pid_rusage RUSAGE_INFO_V0; per-process physical footprint summed per bundle/ancestor app; footprint includes compressed accounting, RSS is separate and is not total memory pressure
grouped_process_memory.grouping: First .app bundle in own/ancestor process path; other executables grouped by path. Attribution is not a complete dependency inventory.
grouped_process_memory.compressed_note: Do not subtract RSS from footprint to invent compressed bytes; host compression is independently available in vm_stat.
grouped_process_memory.scope_caveat: These are current-UID footprint sums and per-process accounting, not unique resident RAM that will certainly become free. Shared pages/accounting can overlap. Per-process compressed byte counts are not available in rusage_info_v0; do not infer them by subtracting RSS. Host compressor metrics above are separate.

suggestions_for_user_if_pressure_stays_2.action: Ask user to quit normally if playback is not needed; do not close automatically.
Ask user to quit normally after preserving needed tabs and after browser-dependent crawl work is done; do not close automatically.

protected_dependencies: KS KB and its Ollama embeddinggemma backend
Docker and its possible Virtualization VM
grouped_process_memory.ollama_note: Initial snapshot showed embeddinggemma1.1GB with imminent natural expiry. Later Ollama grouped process footprint is about38MiB. This is consistent with natural unload but is not a fresh ollama ps inventory; no unload/stop was requested or performed.

primary_source_verification.api_result: generate forwards keyword arguments through stream_generate to generate_step; use kwargs in Python rather than assuming a model context-limit flag.
primary_source_verification.prefill_result: Default2048; smaller prefill chunks are evaluated and allocator cache cleared between chunks. Chunking preserves prompt tokens; it is not truncation.
primary_source_verification.kv_result: Default quantization start5000 means KV quantization stays inactive for our short budget unless explicitly set to0. Do not combine quantized KV with max_kv_size: RotatingKVCache.to_quantized raises NotImplementedError.
primary_source_verification.qwen3_compatibility: Qwen3 Attention forwards cache to base scaled_dot_product_attention; cache.bits selects the quantized attention path. The1.7B head dimension128 is divisible by group64. Source-level compatibility is verified; actual installed versions and runtime behavior must still pass the bounded probe.

proposed_uniform_run_config.note: Proposed settings to be frozen identically for all3 modes before any evaluated answer. They change numerical/cache conditions relative to historical runs; compare within this experiment and disclose the difference. Verify actual pinned model config against the source-level shape assumptions.

memory_estimate.method: KV only: 2(K,V) × layers28 × kv_heads8 × head_dim128 × allocated_tokens. Full cache2 bytes/element. KV4 group64 estimate0.5 +4/64 bytes/element for quantized payload plus2-byte scale and bias each.
memory_estimate.interpretation: At input1400+output384, KV4 saves about141MiB of persistent KV relative to FP16/BF16, not multiple GiB. It cannot by itself resolve a heavily pressured host.

numerical_and_peak_risks: Quantized KV changes numerical results and can change correctness. Freeze it uniformly across all arms; do not turn it off only for a weak-scoring arm.

The quantized attention implementation materializes attention scores and softmax while the unquantized path uses mx.fast SDPA. Smaller persistent KV does not guarantee a lower transient peak or faster execution at short context.
Converting the first chunk to quantized KV temporarily needs source and destination buffers. prefill128 limits the initial conversion size but this is not a measured peak guarantee.
Smaller prefill generally reduces prompt-step activation/logit buffers while potentially reducing throughput. No speed or memory-success promise before measurement.
The sampled footprint guard can only stop observed overruns; it is not a kernel hard allocation cap.

context_budget_policy.overflow_action: Reject or use a predeclared query-independent budgeting/retrieval rule. Never silently drop evidence and still call the arm full-source. Freeze any1400→1600/2000 change and repeat the resource probe before evaluation.
context_budget_policy.fairness: If a full-source arm cannot fit complete selected source at1400 tokens, its definition must be made truthful before evaluation; do not select a shorter source based on model answers or count its missing facts as retrieval capability.

entry_conditions: Three normal pressure1 readings roughly10s apart after crawl/index preparation
No swap growth during readiness window; current swap amount need not be zero
Single model job, fixed local pinned weights, locked versions, no background training or download
Tokenize all final prompts without model compute; verify max input1400 and source coverage policy
probe_after_entry_only: One bounded non-exam representative prompt at the longest planned input with prefill128/KV4start0/group64 and max output384 under the tightened guard
Record child-tree physical footprint/RSS, host pressure, swap delta, prompt/output token count, wall time, MLX peak memory and finish reason
Proceed only on exit0, no protective stop, normal pressure throughout, no swap growth and adequate measured margin below3.5GiB
If EOS ends early, state that the full384-token KV bound was estimated rather than completely exercised
On failure stop, preserve evidence and revise only resource configuration prospectively; never weaken host-pressure protection or repeatedly retry under warning pressure

guard_plan.changed_from_historical: Footprint6→3.5GiB and swap growth0.75→0.25GiB are tighter. Host pressure gate unchanged.

cleanup_plan.scope: Dedicated new DeFi runtime only, via its exact marker UUID and own PID identities; persistent results archive remains.
required: Store raw responses/resources/frozen protocol/retrieval evidence/report in defi-v5 and verify readback/manifest before deleting runtime
Stop only owned inference/helper processes; no KS KB/Ollama/Docker/browser/app termination as cleanup
Keep HF/PIP/XDG/pycache/TMP caches in runtime; no installs/global profiles or daemons

Fresh cache per question; between arms either release all references/gc and own allocator cache, or let the owned process exit. Ending a subprocess releases its model allocations without stopping unrelated services.
After all3 modes finish verify no owned process holds runtime files, dry-run, apply exact UUID cleanup, verify root absence and actual disk-free delta separately from logical bytes
cleanup_plan.not_claimed: No promise of removing OS-managed caches or changing unrelated app memory; historical reports/knowledge bases remain.

recommendation: Finish public-data preparation without model work, ask user about Spotify/Brave only if pressure stays2, then remeasure. Use the proposed conservative uniform config only after readiness and a successful guarded probe. No current approval to infer follows from this source review.
